name: – Nils Ušakovs, Michalis Hadjipantela – After § 21 – Am 90
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2027
part_text: 21b. Recalls that the Asylum, Migration, and Integration Fund (AMIF) has failed to fulfill its role for years and that, rather than contributing effectively to the fight against illegal immigration, it has encouraged the continuation of irregular migration flows; condemns the fact that the agreement on the new European Union Pact on Migration and Asylum was concluded in contradiction to the conclusions of the European Council of December 15, 2016, and June 28, 2018, in the absence of consensus among Member States on the reform of asylum and migration policy; calls, therefore, for the resources of the AMIF to be redirected as a matter of priority toward the effective management of migration flows, in particular by strengthening external border controls, resolutely combating illegal immigration, and funding concrete measures aimed at ensuring the safety of European citizens;
